description: This file defines the CommandContext class which manages the processing and settlement of command messages in an AMQP-based messaging system within the Eclipse Hono client. It handles message acceptance, release, modification, rejection, and disposition, along with associated tracing and credit flow logic.

classes.name: CommandContext
classes.description: A context class encapsulating the state and behaviors needed for processing an AMQP command message, including message settlement and tracing integration.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Factory method to create a new CommandContext instance with the provided command, delivery, receiver, and span.

methods.name: getCommand
methods.description: Returns the command associated with this context.

methods.name: getReceiver
methods.description: Returns the AMQP receiver link over which the command was received.

methods.name: getDelivery
methods.description: Returns the delivery object representing the message.

methods.name: getCurrentSpan
methods.description: Returns the OpenTracing span used for tracing the command processing.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Settles the command message with an accepted outcome, flowing 0 credits, and finishes the span.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts the command message with the specified number of credits and completes the tracing span.

methods.name: release
methods.description: Releases the command message with 0 credits and finishes the span.

methods.name: release
methods.description: Releases the command message with the specified credits and completes the span.

methods.name: modify
methods.description: Modifies the command message outcome, flows credits, and finishes the span.

methods.name: reject
methods.description: Rejects the message with 0 credits, with optional error condition.

methods.name: reject
methods.description: Rejects the message with specified credits and optional error condition, finishing the tracing span.

methods.name: disposition
methods.description: Disposes the message with the given delivery state and 0 credits.

methods.name: disposition
methods.description: Disposes the message with specified delivery state and credits, finishing the span.

methods.name: flow
methods.description: Issues credits to the sender if manual credit handling is required (receiver's prefetch is <= 0).
